title: Count Digits in an Integer
question: Read an integer and count its digits using a loop.
code:
number = abs(int(input("Integer: ")))
count = 1
while number >= 10:
    number //= 10
    count += 1
print("Digits:", count)
explanation: Repeated integer division by 10 removes the last digit until one digit remains; zero is handled as one digit.
